limitations: Discovery diagnostics are not a complete denominator. Async/generator handlers, directives, unused private functions and other early exclusions may be silent.
Nearest misses have exactly one emitted diagnostic; discovery stops at the first failure, so fixing it may reveal others.

Reachability is a conservative identifier-reference graph through local TypeScript-resolved symbols, not a request trace. Dynamic imports, framework magic, namespace property calls and dependency code may be missing; references may overcount calls.
Static acceptance does not guarantee stock compiler acceptance or a speedup. No application config files are executed. Wrapped top-level callbacks count as one callable binding.
Runtime state is process-local (dispatcher.snapshot()). No running app is contacted. Capture snapshots in the app for observed decisions.

measurements.computeIntensityUnit: JS ns per input JSON byte
notes: Native includes checked argument encoding, native execution and result decoding. JS uses the extracted original closure with raw internal calls.
Decision uses an uninstrumented addon and dispatcher paired thresholds; stage share uses a separate instrumented wall probe.
Prediction excludes wrapper overhead, training quotas, traffic distribution, periodic rechecks and host deployment costs. It is not an observed promotion or application saving.
